description: Post-lowering AST conformance for grids/cartesian_uniform_1d/rules/ppm_D_inflow_bc. Every binding loads fixture.esm (N bound to 8 at the import edge), inlines the ppm_face_value / ppm_limit_right / ppm_flux / ppm_D_interior body-reference templates (esm-spec 9.7.3), runs the section-9.6.3 rewrite fixpoint, and must emit a byte-identical expanded AST: D(u,x) replaced by the rule's makearray (interior conservative PPM flux-difference aggregate (F_{i+1/2}-F_{i-1/2})/dx over [4,6] with the CW84-limited semi-discrete upwind edge flux; the five explicit boundary faces i=1,2,3 near the inflow wall carrying the free name gL in the upstream ghost slots and F_{1/2}=gL, and i=7,8 near the outflow wall with the zeroth-order extrapolation ghost u[8]), fired at priority 10, with zero apply_expression_template nodes, zero unlowered rewrite-target ops, zero surviving metaparameter names, and the free names dx and gL surviving. The golden is generated by the Julia reference runner only (scripts/regenerate-goldens.sh) and compared bytewise by the other bindings.
